short.lead: The goose v2 body is rebuilt as you approved. Each rib is now a ridge in the skin with bare bone tearing out of its middle, the leg rings are gone, and feathers hang over the thighs and shoulders. Muscle, a sagging belly and folds at the neck root are part of the skin. The build passed all its checks: 299,188 triangles against the 300,000 budget, 6.750 m tall, and a skin that is still one piece. Version 1 is unchanged.
short.hint: Tap a step to see what was checked and what it needs from you.
items: Bare bone tearing through the flank

The first rebuild hid the bone inside its ridge, because both sat on the same line. The bone is now lifted outward in the middle of each rib, so it breaks clear of the skin and sinks back in at both ends.

items: Ragged feathers hang over each thigh and hide where the leg meets the belly. The five rings on each shank are gone; Issue #20 (textures) paints scales there.

items.caption: The hip.
